This [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]''', with [[Unidentified Rebel pilot 2 (Arda II)|another pilot]], accompanied [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Arda II]]. The three were sent to convince manufacturers on that world to stop supplying [[Starship/Legends|starship]] technology to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. This man argued with the executives. He also had a mustache.
